updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.4.10 
- Add F-4E WSO additional Ground commands 
- Fix Airbase name truncation issue Krasnodar-Pashkovsky 
- Fix F-4E dialog visibility issue 
- OKB FLT PLN Tab enhancments and Client display name detection 
- OKB FLT PLN tab Pilot List for Flight Single Player or Multiplayer (WIP) 
- Fix Saved games folder search for OKB Flt Plan Files 
- fix Execute external plugin OKB commands not working with auto browse disabled 
- OKB Out FLT PLN Tab fix bugs in DTC import handling F-16C 
- OKB Out FLT PLN Tab SA MAP add B/E marker and ability to bug D-Link Asset for B/E and BRA readout. 
- Tidy up logging of asset classes and reduce updates whe server process snapshot has required data (performance improvement). 
- OKB Out refine D-Link target labels and asset vaidation 
- OKB out NAVLOG add DIR TO and DEL functions to STP rows (WIP, still a little clunky) 
- Fix minor OKB out update loop issue with Player callsign causing NAVLOG refresh. 
- Fix OKB Out text select with stylus creating highlighting. 
- Reworked DIR TO and DEL STP actions to be more robust and respect button armed condition slight change to action and now highlights row when armed. 
- New F-14 AIRIO handling to allow multiplayer use on servers with 'require pure cient scripts' enabled No mini wheel available 
- Fix persistence of Jester Mini Wheel Checkbox, now will remeber configuration. 
- Add OKB connection notifier to Vaicom PTT Tab. 
- Add OKB Out Tab to Vaicom UI and move features from Expansion Tab. 
- Decouple Auto Browse for DCS kneeboard and OKB Out dashboard, now have independant selections.
